candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its downstream order call times out: traces show POST order and POST payment failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s), while inventory/redis calls succeed in ms. The order service's payment dependency stalls, propagating latency to the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order/payment (e.g. payment-side stall vs order-side timeout config) not isolated; no payment service telemetry provided.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with ~2s transport ReadTimeouts on the order->payment path in traces and gateway client logs; inventory/redis succeed quickly. Gateway p95 for /v1/checkout ~2387ms matches the timeout window, indicating downstream latency rather than gateway-local fault.
